title: 1801 Prairie's slate roof behind its south gable
items: Behind the Kimball house's carved south gable a steep slate roof now runs back into the main roof, its ridge just under the gable's top. Taylor's c. 1895 photograph and the 1965 survey photograph both show it.
The iron cresting along the front now stops at that roof, and the corner finial stands on its ridge's far end, where both photographs put it.
